questions.evidence:
[Shuttle notice] On festival Saturday, the last station-to-park bus leaves at 8:30 p.m.; the last park-to-station bus leaves at 9:10 p.m. The park stop is at the east entrance. Event tickets do not include the bus fare.

[Walking guide] From the main stage to the east stop takes fifteen minutes. From the west entrance to the east stop takes ten minutes. There is no festival shuttle at the west entrance. Times assume a direct walk without stopping.

[Milo's plan] Milo wants to watch a show at the main stage until 8:50 and keep at least five minutes before the last return departure. He already has an event ticket. His friend suggests waiting at the west entrance because it looks closer.

Milo reads the route direction, walking guide, and fare note together. The festival timetable is for this Saturday only, so he saves the normal timetable separately for Monday. A workable plan must connect the right place, date, direction, and time.
